why: A page that moves from Chromium to WebKit when the live web loop turns on (cmux #36435, cmuxterm-hq#7149 L8) keeps the keys: PageChromiumPage gains hasKeys, whose one real conformer is the App's CEFPageChromiumPage (the only place that knows both the protocol and CEFTab; CmuxNextPages cannot depend on CmuxNextBrowser, and a protocol default of false would bring back the lost keys). The AppDelegate paneFocus line is replaced, not added.
